It starts with what we put on their plates. Our kids deserve real food, not a bowl of sugar, to start their day.

The MAHA movement is working to put real food, better nutrition, and healthier choices back at the center of American families’ lives.

This Congress, we introduced more than 100 bills, ranking fifth in the entire House and introducing more bills than any other member of the South Carolina House delegation.

We fought to protect women and children, secure our borders, stand up for our veterans, military, and first responders, and defend the Constitution our Founders built this nation on.

The fight isn’t finished. Neither are we.

posts.text:
Lowcountry restaurants shouldn’t have to compete against bots for control of their own tables.

We introduced the SEAT Act to stop shady third-party platforms from listing and reselling restaurant reservations without permission. These services profit while local restaurants deal with no-shows, lost revenue, and zero accountability.

The SEAT Act puts control back where it belongs: with the restaurants.
